title: Certify arrays over uninterpreted sorts (QF_AX) in Lean via clause log
summary: Z3 refutations over arrays from one uninterpreted sort to another (QF_AX) can now be certified in Lean through the clause log, with every array fact proved as a theorem in the generated file. 23 of z3test's 25 QF_AX samples now verify, up from none.
